groups.defect: The GrafanaRuleListItem returned by the filtered-results map lacks its React key, allowing row state to migrate between rules.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same dropped key prop in the Grafana branch of FilterView. Restoring key={key} resolves every report.

groups.defect: The Silence action is available for prom-only rules, but its drawer requires a ruler rule, so clicking the action does nothing.
groups.rationale: One report points to the prom-only caller and the other to the drawer's ruler-rule guard. Both describe the same broken silence flow.

groups.defect: Delegating CombinedRule ability checks to useAllRulerRuleAbilities drops the federated-group immutability check.
groups.rationale: Both reports identify the same lost federation check and resulting availability of modification actions for federated rules.
